patch.objective: Designing and implementing a versioning strategy for pipeline artifacts

sources.cite: Microsoft Learn, Study guide for Exam AZ-400: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions (page last updated 2026-10-30): processes and communications 10-15%, source control strategy 10-15%, build and release pipelines 50-55%, security and compliance plan 10-15%, instrumentation strategy 5-10%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Bullets quoted there: 'Design a deployment strategy, including blue-green, canary, ring, progressive exposure, feature flags, and A/B testing'; 'Implement feature flags by using Azure App Configuration Feature Manager'; 'Plan for minimizing downtime during deployments by using load balancing, rolling deployments, and deployment slot usage and swap'. The objective wording is the course seed's. (read for this round by an earlier pass on 2026-11-17)

sources.cite: Microsoft Learn, Azure Resource Manager template reference, Microsoft.Compute galleries/images/versions (API 2026-03-03)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Quoted: excludeFromLatest, 'If set to true, Virtual Machines deployed from the latest version of the Image Definition won't use this Image Version'; endOfLifeDate, 'can be used for decommissioning purposes. This property is updatable.' A version excluded from latest can still be referenced explicitly. That a session host keeps the image it was built from until it is replaced follows from how VM images work (stated as the author's); the az sig commands are authored renderings.
